body.x: Interview about IFA 2012 Plan at CES 2012Q1. Introduce IFA!A. IFA is CE convention opening in germany in september where many retailers from all over the world would attend, exhibit and create networks with other retailers.Q2. What are your thoughts of CES and is there anything for them to make it better?A. First of all we love CES. CES gathers all manufacturers and buyers from many countries and introduces some of the concept and best products of that year. IFA starts on September, focusing on Christmas and holiday season which is another big season for the market as well.Q3. Will you share some plans/agenda for 2012 IFA?A. First of all, that's a great question. We plan on inviting a lot more international companies. It will make the network to grow more globally which will eventually make the industry more globalized.Go to 'CES 2012' Special Page
